name: io.github.mveyseldelibas/earthdiff
title: earthdiff
description: Satellite eyes for AI assistants: what changed here? Free Sentinel-2 imagery, no account or API key.

environmentVariables.name: EARTHDIFF_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where reports and images are written (default ~/earthdiff-mcp-output).

environmentVariables.name: EARTHDIFF_MAX_AREA_KM2
environmentVariables.description: Largest area one analysis may cover, in km2 (default and maximum 2000; set it lower to limit run time).
